calls.statement:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period
),
sold_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.sale_date, cs.format, s.format AS format_on_date, f.net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s     ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_store cs    ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN dim_product p   ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d      ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
      AND d.fiscal_period = params.fiscal_period
),
refunds AS (
    SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT l.format,
       COUNT(*) AS n_lines,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.format<>l.format_on_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fmt_diff,
       SUM(l.net_amount) AS sold_net,
       COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) AS returned_net,
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) / SUM(l.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct,
       MAX(l.sale_date) + 30 <= (SELECT MAX(calendar_date) FROM dim_date) AS cohort_complete
FROM sold_lines l
LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

calls.statement:
SELECT w.status, count(distinct w.web_order_id) orders, count(*) n_lines, sum(f.net_amount) sold_net, sum(r.refund_net) refunds
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT sales_line_id, sum(refund_net) refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1) r ON r.sales_line_id=f.sales_line_id
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=2
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
